User Story: As a patient, I want to browse doctors by specialty so that I can find a suitable clinician.
As a patient, I want to view a doctor's available appointment slots so that I can choose a convenient time.
As a patient, I want to book an available appointment slot so that I can reserve a consultation.
As a patient, I want to receive a booking confirmation so that I know my appointment is scheduled.
As a patient, I want to view my upcoming appointments so that I can manage my visits.
As a patient, I want to select another available slot for an existing appointment so that I can change my visit time.
As a patient, I want to cancel an appointment within the allowed policy so that the slot can be made available to others.
As a patient, I want confirmation after cancellation so that I know the appointment is no longer active.
As a patient, I want to choose an available reminder channel so that I receive appointment reminders in a useful way.
As a patient, I want to receive a reminder before my appointment so that I can prepare to attend.
As a doctor, I want to view my published appointment schedule so that I can plan my clinic sessions.
As authorised clinic staff, I want to block a doctor's unavailable time so that patients cannot book during that period.
